purpose: Claim gate for separate atomic-physics branches inside the topic.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Accepted hydrogen-spectrum benchmark branch using the standard Rydberg relation with source-backed NIST/CODATA working copies.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need a first-principles derivation before promoting beyond a benchmark branch.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Accepted atomic-constant consistency branch for `R_H` and related hydrogen residual checks.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Constant consistency does not independently validate atomic theory or UET derivation.
Need a dedicated level-energy artifact with threshold policy.
Need source-backed precision datasets and dedicated residual artifacts.
Need dedicated helium and many-electron datasets plus artifacts.
Need derivation and validation beyond the standard hydrogen Rydberg benchmark.

claim_boundary: This gate keeps the topic at hydrogen benchmark status, not full atomic-theory closure.
